prompt: Response schemas declared per content type (schema.response[status].content['application/json'].schema) are silently skipped when the reply's Content-Type has whitespace before the parameters, for example 'application/json ; charset=utf-8', 'application/json\t; charset=utf-8' or 'application/json ;'. The reply is then serialised without the schema, so fields the schema would remove (a schema with additionalProperties: false) leak to the client. Fix the response schema lookup so it uses the media type parsed from the Content-Type with Fastify's ContentType parser (lib/content-type.js), so that any whitespace (spaces or tabs) around the media type is ignored, for every kind of response schema: an exact status code (200), and the 'default' response. Example: with the 200 schema { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, properties: { public: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['public'] } under 'application/json', sending { public: 'ok', secret: 'SHOULD_BE_STRIPPED' } must return 200 with the body { public: 'ok' } for each of those Content-Type values; the same holds when that schema is declared under the 'default' response instead of 200.
requirement: getSchemaSerializer looks up response[status].content[mediaType] (and the 'NXX' and 'default' fallbacks) using the media type parsed by ContentType (trimmed, lowercased, valid), not the raw text before ';'. Whitespace or a tab before ';' and a trailing ' ;' all select the 'application/json' schema, which then strips undeclared properties.

oracle.approved_by: Arshad Ahmed Shaik (delegated approval; AI technical review by Claude)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: with Content-Type 'application/json ; charset=utf-8', the 200 'application/json' schema applies: { public: 'ok', secret: 'SHOULD_BE_STRIPPED' } is sent as { public: 'ok' }
a schema declared under the 'default' response is applied the same way for 'application/json ; charset=utf-8'

adjudication_rules: Score pass only if every hidden check passes. No partial credit.

provenance.author: Claude (QB developer side; dev screen, harder candidates)
provenance.notes: Real defect in fastify v5.8.5 (response schema lookup by raw text before ';', so whitespace skips the schema and leaks fields), fixed upstream in c06fc06d (#6685). The reference is that fix applied to v5.8.5. The hidden suite is the upstream whitespace, tab and trailing-semicolon tests plus the 'default' case the prompt states. Upper-case media types are out of scope at this base: reply.send rejects them before the lookup (fixed later upstream, see FY-12).
